findings.title: NewFetcher cleanup path untested when itemClient creation fails
findings.suggested_fix: Add test case: TestNewFetcher_ItemClientFailure that verifies client.Close() is called when itemClient creation fails (e.g., via invalid proxy). Mock NewClient to fail on second call to verify cleanup.

findings.title: NewFetcherWithProxyPool cleanup path untested when itemClient creation fails
findings.suggested_fix: Add test case: TestNewFetcherWithProxyPool_ItemClientFailure that verifies client.Close() is called when itemClient creation fails. This mirrors the error path in NewFetcher.

findings.title: itemClient.Close() failure mode untested in Yad2Fetcher.Close()
findings.suggested_fix: While TestYad2Fetcher_Close_Idempotent exists, it doesn't verify itemClient cleanup specifically. Consider adding assertions that both client and itemClient are properly closed, though nil-checking makes this low risk.

findings.title: Enrich consecutive failure reset boundary not fully tested
findings.suggested_fix: TestEnricher_ConsecutiveFailureResets tests failure-success-success pattern but not the exact boundary: 2 consecutive failures, success (reset), then 3 consecutive failures should abort on 4th request in second run. Add test verifying counter fully resets.

residual_risks.description: Client isolation effectiveness not verified end-to-end
residual_risks.mitigation: TestYad2Fetcher_FetchItem_DoesNotPoisonListingClient verifies cookies don't leak between clients via HTTP round-trip test. Actual azuretls cookie jar isolation relies on library behavior (two separate Client instances).

residual_risks.description: looksLikeGenericError may have false positives on legitimate 400/403 pages
residual_risks.mitigation: Function checks for generic nginx/CDN error page HTML structure. TestLooksLikeGenericError covers happy/sad paths with specific HTML. Risk: legitimate Yad2 400 pages misclassified as bot protection.

testing_gaps.description: Resource cleanup when constructor fails mid-way
testing_gaps.recommendation: Add fault injection tests for both NewFetcher and NewFetcherWithProxyPool that fail itemClient creation and verify client cleanup. This is a standard constructor error path pattern.

testing_gaps.description: Consecutive failure counter reset at maxConsecutiveFailures boundary
testing_gaps.recommendation: Add test: 2 failures -> success -> 3 failures should abort after 3 more failures (6 total requests), verifying the counter fully resets to 0 on success, not just below threshold.
